calculation.description: Ranks assets by recent five-session underperformance after scaling by trailing 20-session realized volatility. Larger values indicate relatively beaten-down, lower-risk-adjusted recent returns and predict subsequent cross-sectional returns.
calculation.forward_horizon: 1 trading day primary; 5 and 10 day decay reported

signal_provenance.construction: Each date uses only close observations through that date; forward returns begin after the factor timestamp.

validation.regime_notes: The runtime-aligned dataset produced 101 usable cross-sectional dates, all with 15 valid instruments; uncertainty is material because the usable date count is much smaller than the nominal 2020-2026 span. Positive daily IC and ICIR clear the benchmark gates, with positive decay at 5 and 10 sessions. Coverage is reduced by the warm-up requirements and available date intersection; revalidate regularly.
